text: Find Events uses str.normalize().toLowerCase for both query and values. Current search covers SUMMARY,DESCRIPTION,LOCATION,URL and guards missing values. Normalize the query once, rather than once per item/property. Default NFC normalization handles canonical equivalence; this does not claim locale-specific case folding or accent stripping.
title: Normalize both filter query and every searched property
